opis: Szybkie wbicie 115–120% na krótkich, mocnych zdaniach. Powolne wejście z cofnięciem na dłuższych. Zawsze centruje twarz. Obraz żyje razem z głosem.
najlepsze_do: Mówione podkreślenia, zmiana rytmu, emocjonalne momenty, eksperckie stwierdzenia

przepis.opis_efektu: Two zoom behaviors tied to sentence length and emphasis: (1) Short emphasis lines (under 4 words, spoken with force): quick punch-in zoom from 1.0 to 1.15–1.20 scale in 100ms, holds for the line's duration, then snaps back to 1.0 on the cut. (2) Longer lines (full sentences): slow push-in from 1.0 to 1.08 over the sentence duration, then eases back to 1.0 by the end of the sentence or on the cut. Both behaviors: always re-center on the face after scaling — never let the face drift to the edge. Never zoom past 1.25. Apply selectively — not on every line, only on lines that deserve emphasis based on the script.
